prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 4:5 vertical 85mm country-garden fashion portrait of an adult woman with medium-brown hair moving gently in a summer breeze, luminous natural skin, and a relaxed dreamy smile. She wears a pastel-pink floral cotton midi dress with short sleeves, high neckline, fitted waist, full mid-calf skirt, and a simple pearl necklace. Pose her standing among pink hydrangeas, one hand lightly adjusting hair. Include trimmed boxwood hedges and an anonymous softly blurred brick cottage. Use warm golden-hour foliage-filtered sun, creamy bokeh, natural skin, refined fabric folds, lifelike flowers, gentle grain, realistic hands, and no body emphasis. No property name, logo, readable text, or watermark.
